notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.notes:
- New scrollable leaderboards that show stage progress & character used
- Changed tutorial progression, only the Gunvein Basics tutorial is mandatory now
- Fixed boss timeout crash
- Added an invincibility cancel to make scoring less frustrating (quickly tap both shot + lockon twice when invincible)
- Added fragment count set up into practice mode
- Some other small fixes/tweaks

notes.title: Gunvein Release Date 11th November
notes.notes:
We are happy to finally have the release date for our first PC/Steam game. 
Gunvein releases on Steam this Friday 11th November.

notes.title: Gunvein DEMO update
notes.notes:
Demo changes:

 Arcade mode + online leader boards
 Full 360 screen rotation + an option to link controls to rotation
 Analog controls when using gamepad
 More in depth effect settings
 Redesigned stage 1 (and the other stages)
 Adjusted enemy & boss difficulty
 Changed ship balancing, Type B should no longer be as dominant
 Consistent gold medal spawns, reworked bombs & hypers
 Score Rush is easier to clear
 Progress bars on arcade & roguelike modes
 Lots of smaller adjustments
